site.name: Pet Fresh Food Decisions
site.tagline: Fresh dog food delivery and subscriptions - Ollie, The Farmer's Dog and JustFoodForDogs prices, plans, shipping and promos, with every fact read from the brand's own official page and shown with its source URL and check date.

brands.name: Ollie
brands.short_answer: Ollie sells human-grade fresh dog food as a subscription. Its own Meal Plans page publishes starting prices - Full Fresh Meals from $1.57 a meal and the Half Fresh Plan from $1.00 a meal - and ollie.com advertised a first-box discount with a free hat and dog bandana on the check date, though the banner figure differed between readings (50% at 19:06 UTC+8, 70% at 19:21).
brands.price_condition: Full Fresh Meals are listed as 'Starting at $1.57 a meal' and the budget Half Fresh Plan as 'Starting at $1.00 a meal' on Ollie's Meal Plans page. These are starting prices: Ollie prices your individual plan inside its plan builder, so the per-meal figure for your dog comes from the quote, not from the public page. First-order promo as published on ollie.com on the check date: the banner offered a first box discount plus a free hat and dog bandana, reading 50% off in the Meal Plans page HTML at 19:06 (UTC+8) and 70% off on the homepage at 19:21 the same day - confirm the banner at checkout.

facts.fact: Ollie's Full Fresh Meals plan is published as 'Starting at $1.57 a meal'.
facts.condition: Printed under Full Fresh Meals (Premium) on the Meal Plans page; Ollie describes the plan as made from 100% human-grade meat, fruits, veggies, and grains.

facts.fact: Ollie's Half Fresh Plan is published as 'Starting at $1.00 a meal'.
facts.condition: Printed under Half Fresh Plan (budget friendly) on the same Meal Plans page; Ollie describes it as a freshly made half-serving added to the dog's mealtime.

facts.fact: Ollie's own pages advertised a first-box discount with a free hat and dog bandana on 2026-09-26, but the figure was not stable: the Meal Plans page HTML read '50% off your first box' at 19:06 (UTC+8) and the homepage read '70% off your first box + free hat and dog bandana' at 19:21 the same day.
facts.condition: Both readings are ollie.com's own banner text on the check date, taken 15 minutes apart; like all promotions it can change or end without notice, so confirm the banner at checkout.

facts.fact: Ollie lists five recipes: Beef, Chicken, Lamb, Turkey and Pork.
facts.condition: Recipe list on the Meal Plans page, where Beef is marked POPULAR; Ollie says you can choose one recipe or mix and match.

facts.fact: Ollie says its meals are made from 100% human-grade meat, fruits, veggies, and grains, with meat always the first ingredient, no added hormones or fillers, and no common allergens like corn, wheat, or soy.
facts.condition: Ingredient claims printed in the 'What mealtime is made of' section of the Meal Plans page.

facts.fact: Ollie's homepage publishes the stats 1M+ Dogs Served, 135K+ Health Check-Ins and 20K+ 5-Star Reviews.
facts.condition: Homepage stats block as displayed on the check date; these are Ollie's own figures, not independently audited on that page.

facts.fact: Ollie lists 'Free Shipping' as one of the homepage banner values, next to 'Vet+Chef Developed' and 'Human Grade'; the Meal Plans page title reads 'Dog Meal Plans | Free Delivery | Ollie'.
facts.condition: Both are Ollie's own wording on the check date; the pages do not print a minimum order for free delivery.

facts.fact: Ollie's support channels are email caninecare@ollie.com and phone/text 844-88-OLLIE (65543), plus live chat with canine support.
facts.condition: Listed in the 'Get more help' block of Ollie's FAQ page.

faqs.a: Ollie publishes starting prices only: Full Fresh Meals from $1.57 a meal and the Half Fresh Plan from $1.00 a meal. The price for an individual dog is produced by Ollie's plan builder, so treat the published figures as the floor, not the final bill.
Five: Beef, Chicken, Lamb, Turkey and Pork. Ollie says you can choose a single recipe or mix and match them, and that meat is always the first ingredient with no added hormones or fillers.
Ollie labels its Full Fresh Meals as made from 100% human-grade meat, fruits, veggies, and grains, and its homepage banner carries a 'Human Grade' value alongside 'Vet+Chef Developed'.

faqs.q: Does Ollie have a first-order discount?
faqs.a: Yes, as published on the check date: ollie.com advertised a first-box discount plus a free hat and dog bandana. The banner figure was not stable that day - 50% off in the Meal Plans page HTML at 19:06 (UTC+8) and 70% off on the homepage at 19:21 - so treat it as dynamic and confirm the current terms on Ollie's site before ordering.

faqs.q: How do I get a price for my own dog?
faqs.a: Use Ollie's plan builder (the Get Started flow on ollie.com), which asks about your dog and then shows the plan. The public pages only show the starting price per meal.

faqs.q: How do I contact Ollie support?
faqs.a: Email caninecare@ollie.com, call or text 844-88-OLLIE (65543), or use live chat with canine support - all three are listed on Ollie's FAQ page.

brands.name: The Farmer's Dog
brands.short_answer: The Farmer's Dog delivers vet-developed fresh food on a subscription. Its FAQ publishes the number everyone asks for: plans start at about $2/day, delivery options mostly range from 1 week to 2 months of food, and shipping is free. The site currently advertises 50% off your first purchase.
brands.price_condition: The Farmer's Dog FAQ states plans start at about $2/day, that the exact price depends on your dog's age, weight, activity and recipe choice, that delivery options mostly range from 1 week to 2 months of food, and that shipping is included. Current first-order promo shown on the site: 50% off your first purchase.

facts.fact: The Farmer's Dog FAQ states plans start at about $2/day.
facts.condition: Verbatim from the FAQ answer to 'What does The Farmer's Dog cost?', which adds that the exact plan and price depend on age, weight, activity, recipe choice and more.

facts.fact: The Farmer's Dog says delivery options mostly range from 1 week to 2 months of food and include free shipping.
facts.condition: Same FAQ answer; the homepage separately advertises 'Free shipping with any plan'.

facts.fact: The Farmer's Dog ships to the 48 contiguous states.
facts.condition: Stated in the FAQ answer on how shipments work; Fresh food arrives in refrigerated, eco-friendly boxes and Instant Fresh can be stored in the pantry.

facts.fact: You can pause, cancel or reactivate your The Farmer's Dog subscription anytime.
facts.condition: FAQ answer to 'Can I cancel or reactivate my subscription anytime?', which says the controls live in your Customer Account. The homepage also lists 'Cancel anytime'.

facts.fact: The Farmer's Dog offers two serving styles - Fresh (gently cooked, frozen) and Instant Fresh (shelf-stable, gently dried) - with recipes featuring beef, chicken, turkey and pork.
facts.condition: FAQ answers on recipes and on what 'fresh' means; the brand says recipes are complete and balanced to AAFCO standards with no extra supplementation needed.

facts.fact: The Farmer's Dog offers both grain-free and grain-inclusive recipes, and lists pork and turkey as less-common proteins it sells.
facts.condition: FAQ answers 'Do your recipes have grains?' and 'Do you have novel proteins?'.

facts.fact: Only feed Fresh packs that arrive frozen or very cold - the food should still be below 40°F; partial defrosting is okay.
facts.condition: FAQ answer on how to tell whether Fresh food is safe when it arrives.

facts.fact: If your dog doesn't like the food, The Farmer's Dog says it can send additional recipes to try, or you can opt for a refund if you donate the food to a shelter.
facts.condition: FAQ answer to 'What if my dog doesn't like the food?' - a shelter-donation condition is attached to the refund option.

facts.fact: The homepage currently advertises 'You've been gifted 50% off your first purchase!' and lists free & flexible deliveries, nationwide shipping, eco-friendly packaging and 24-hour customer service as plan features.
facts.condition: Banner and plan-features block as displayed on the check date; promo terms can change.

faqs.q: How much does The Farmer's Dog cost?
faqs.a: Its own FAQ answers this: plans start at about $2/day, and the exact price depends on your dog's age, weight, activity and recipe choice. Delivery options mostly range from 1 week to 2 months of food and include free shipping.
Yes. The FAQ says deliveries include free shipping, and the homepage repeats 'Free shipping with any plan'.
Yes - the FAQ says you can pause, cancel or reactivate anytime from your Customer Account, and the homepage lists 'Cancel anytime' as a plan feature.

faqs.q: Where does The Farmer's Dog ship?
faqs.a: To the 48 contiguous states. Fresh food arrives in refrigerated boxes, and Instant Fresh is shelf-stable for pantry storage.

Human-grade recipes featuring beef, chicken, turkey and pork, in Fresh and Instant Fresh serving styles, with both grain-free and grain-inclusive options. The brand says they are complete and balanced to AAFCO standards.

faqs.q: What happens if my dog doesn't like it?
faqs.a: The Farmer's Dog says it can send additional recipes to try, or you can opt for a refund if you donate the food to a shelter.
The site showed 'You've been gifted 50% off your first purchase!' on the check date. We report it only because the brand's own homepage prints it; check the live page for current terms.

home_faqs.q: What does fresh dog food delivery cost per day?
home_faqs.a: Only two of the three brands publish a per-day or per-meal figure: Ollie lists meals from $1.57 (Full Fresh) and $1.00 (Half Fresh), and The Farmer's Dog says plans start at about $2/day. JustFoodForDogs does not quote a per-day price - it publishes box prices, from $153.99 for a 14-pack of Chicken & Rice.

The Farmer's Dog includes free shipping with any plan; JustFoodForDogs ships free over $49 (or on a first subscription order) and charges $19.99 below that; Ollie lists Free Shipping as a homepage value without printing a minimum.
